messages.subject: dateRangeInput error
parts:
Hi all. Thanks again for Shiny!

I have recently updated shiny and shiny-incubator according to that code that exists in your github repo. I am using the dateRangeInput(), but having a problem. Inserting this input element in it's simplest form is returning an error.

# in ui.R
dateRangeInput("daterange", "Date range:")

# console, after runApp()
Error in as.Date.default(unclass(x)) : 
  do not know how to convert 'unclass(x)' to class “Date”

... I am not sure what is going on here. I tried setting the dates myself, and using as.Date on those definitions, but no luck. I feel I am missing something quite simple. Any help will be appreciated. 

Thanks,
Dan
